description: This is the Pinion Gear which transmits rotation to the steering rack providing mechanical advantage and directional control to the wheels.
This is the Steering Column that mounts and supports the steering shaft and provides structural support to the steering system components.
This is the Steering Wheel which provides the interface for the driver to input rotation and directional control to the steering system and wheels.
This is the Tie Rod that connects the steering rack to the wheel hub providing a mechanical link for directional control and rotation to the wheels.
